title: Your membership. Your voice.
intro: Both membership options support the PTO and give you access to member benefits. Choose the option that works best for your family!
voiceBody: The Thrive PTO is led by a PTO Board and its members, and some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote. Your membership gives you a voice in those decisions.
familyBody: Family Membership includes two voting members from your household, so two parents/guardians can participate in membership votes.
individualBody: Individual Membership includes one voting member from your household.
paymentNote: View current membership details and pricing, and complete your membership on FutureFund.
contactBody: If you run into any issues or have questions about your PTO membership, please reach out. We're happy to help get you connected!
